decisions.reason: As a close-to-core waterproof lined safety range in a growing industry, it likely benefits from the firm's product-development slack and shows no clear failure signal strong enough to trigger problemistic search and withdrawal.

An electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe serves a distinct, recurring workplace need close to the firm's established capabilities, so management would likely continue it unless results clearly fell below aspiration.

A new safety shoe series fits the core business and can be supported by the firm's broad portfolio and R&D resources, though overlap with existing lines makes rationalization somewhat more plausible than for a more differentiated niche product.
